10k.note: FY2025 (year ended July 31, 2025) 10-K. Company explicitly states: 'We are not currently working on any projects' and recorded $0 R&D expense in fiscal 2025. Two early-stage device concepts disclosed (CardioMap heart-monitoring/screening device; Save-A-Life choking rescue device); neither has received FDA clearance. Prior drug candidates (mTBI / Niemann-Pick Type C nasal-delivery program) were sold to Oragenics in December 2023.
